회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

소개

당신의 리더십이 우리의 세일즈를 이끕니다.
에드테크부터 지역 영업까지, 다양한 분야에서 세일즈팀을 이끌 리더를 찾고 있습니다.
지금 인재풀에 등록하시면, 향후 적합한 포지션이 열릴 때 우선적으로 연락드릴 예정입니다.

우리가 찾는 사람

• 세일즈팀을 이끌 수 있는 리더십을 갖춘 분
• 성과 중심의 사고방식과 데이터 기반의 의사결정이 가능한 분
• 커뮤니케이션 능력과 조직 내 협업 역량이 뛰어난 분
• 다양한 산업(테크, B2B, B2C 등) 또는 지역 영업 경험이 있는 분

주요 역할 (포지션에 따라 상이)

• 세일즈 전략 수립 및 실행
• 팀 빌딩 및 퍼포먼스 관리
• 시장 및 고객 분석을 통한 기회 발굴
• 내부 부서와의 협업을 통한 시너지 창출

이런 분께 추천드려요

• 현재 세일즈 리더로 활동 중이며 새로운 도전을 찾고 계신 분
• 다양한 산업군에서의 경험을 바탕으로 확장된 역할을 원하시는 분
• 영업 관리자의 경험을 바탕으로 더 넓은 시장을 리드하고 싶은 분

인재풀 등록 방법

본 채용건에 이력서를 등록해 주세요.
향후 적합한 포지션이 열릴 경우, 우선적으로 연락드리겠습니다.

전형 절차

• 본 공고는 특정 포지션에 대한 채용이 아닌, 향후 채용을 위한 인재풀 등록을 위한 것입니다.
• 등록된 정보는 내부 검토 후, 적합한 포지션이 열릴 경우 개별 연락을 드립니다.

참고 사항

• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
• 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

The Enterprise Data and AI Office is seeking an execution-oriented Enterprise Data Governance Solution Lead to help advance the firm’s enterprise Data Governance framework, standards, control capabilities, and technology-enabled solutions.

This role will focus on translating enterprise data governance policies, standards, regulatory expectations, and control requirements into scalable business processes, platform capabilities, and adoption practices across business and technology teams. This position is part of the Enterprise Data Governance team within the Chief Data and AI Office. POSITION DESCRIPTION

ROLE: SENIOR, TALENT ACQUISITION PARTNER
TEAM: TALENT
LOCATION: TORONTO (HYBRID)

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Salt is a North American marketing agency that creates connected experiences through creative, digital & media innovation.

Our mission is to “Earn the World’s Attention” and Salt is built to find, develop, execute, and amplify the ideas that are worthy of our clients’ audiences. We’ve structured our agency to do what’s right for our clients – to connect different perspectives, to work across mediums, and to focus on delivering meaningful, effective results.

We’re committed to living up to the values in our name. “Salt of The Earth” means we value collaborative, humble, hard-working people here. We’re looking for people who are as smart as they are kind because we believe the right talent and the right culture help us do what’s right for our clients.

ROLE OVERVIEW
As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, you are a trusted strategic partner responsible for leading full-cycle recruitment across key disciplines for Salt and The Kitchen North America. You combine relationship building, operational excellence, and data-driven insight to ensure we attract, hire, and retain the best talent in the market.

Reporting to the Director of Talent, you will play a central role in designing and refining Salt’s hiring practices, shaping our employer brand, and building inclusive pipelines for future growth. You balance hands-on execution with strategic foresight while managing high-priority searches while also mentoring others, improving systems, and helping define what great hiring looks like at Salt.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Talent Acquisition & Sourcing

• Lead end-to-end recruitment for senior and specialized roles across Creative, Strategy, Media, Digital, and Operations.
• Partner with department heads to forecast hiring needs and build proactive sourcing strategies that align with business growth.
• Develop deep pipelines of diverse, high-performing candidates using advanced sourcing techniques, networking, and market research.
• Ensure all job descriptions, postings, and outreach communications reflect Salt’s voice, culture, and inclusive values.
• Coach and mentor Recruiters and hiring managers in sourcing methods, outreach communication, and candidate assessment.

Candidate Experience & Employer Brand

• Own and elevate the candidate experience, ensuring transparency, respect, and consistency across every stage.
• Lead training or enablement for hiring managers on structured interviewing, equitable evaluation, and feedback delivery.
• Partner with Marketing and Talent leadership to develop employer brand initiatives, social content, and campaigns that strengthen Salt’s visibility and appeal.
• Represent Salt and The Kitchen at industry events, panels, and partnerships to grow awareness and attract top-tier talent.
• Regularly assess and improve the recruitment process to ensure a seamless and differentiated experience for all candidates.

Recruitment Analytics & Optimization

• Maintain complete and accurate data within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) to ensure reporting integrity.
• Track key hiring metrics such as time-to-fill, offer acceptance rate, source effectiveness, and pipeline diversity.
• Analyze data to identify recruitment trends and inform adjustments to sourcing strategy and process efficiency.
• Present insights and recommendations to the Director of Talent and Leadership teams to guide workforce planning.
• Drive adoption of standardized tools, templates, and metrics that increase clarity and accountability across the recruiting team.

Strategic Partnership & Stakeholder Influence

• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and hiring managers, guiding them through workforce planning and hiring strategy.
• Lead intake and calibration meetings to define role expectations, success criteria, and interview structures.
• Provide regular updates on search progress, pipeline health, and market conditions to align expectations and inform decisions.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with People & Culture, Finance, and Resource Management to align recruitment activity with organizational priorities and headcount plans.
• Influence stakeholders through data, insight, and relationship building — ensuring that decisions are timely, informed, and inclusive.

Early Talent & Engagement Programs

• Lead the development and delivery of early talent programs, including campus outreach, internships, and entry-level recruitment initiatives.
• Partner with People & Culture to ensure early talent experiences are structured, developmental, and aligned to long-term hiring goals.
Build relationships with schools, professional associations, and community organizations to expand Salt’s early talent pipeline.
• Track early talent program metrics, conversion rates, and participant outcomes to refine future recruitment strategies.
• Champion initiatives that strengthen Salt’s connection to future creative, digital, and marketing professionals.

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS:

• 5–7 years of experience in full-cycle recruitment or talent acquisition, ideally within a creative, digital, or integrated agency environment.
• Proven success managing senior-level searches and leading multiple high-volume or specialized hiring initiatives simultaneously.
• Expertise in sourcing diverse candidates using advanced research, networking, and digital tools.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels of the organization.
• Experience using ATS platforms and analytics tools to track, interpret, and present recruitment data and insights.
• Demonstrated ability to design or improve recruiting processes that increase speed, quality, and consistency.
• Strong understanding of employer branding and experience partnering with marketing or communications to amplify brand presence.
• Leadership experience mentoring recruiters, hiring partners, or cross-functional stakeholders.
• Passion for developing early talent and fostering inclusive, equitable hiring practices.
• Proactive, organized, and adaptable, thriving in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly.

PERKS & BENEFITS THAT SET US APART

We don’t just talk about balance, growth, and culture, we build for it:

• Work-Life Flexibility: Hybrid setup, up to 28 paid days off and winter holiday shutdowns
• Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, and vision plans, plus Salt Bucks to spend on what matters to you—wellness, RRSPs, or extra time off.
• Growth-Driven Culture: Dedicated Salt Days, top-tier learning access, and formal leadership development.
• Celebration-First Mentality: Legendary team trips, seasonal socials, and Salt Swag that reps your squad.
• Real Rewards: Referral and new business bonuses, exclusive lifestyle perks, and personalized wellness options.
• Culture of Belonging: DEI programs, active ERGs, and a workplace where every voice counts.

WHAT WE STAND FOR

• Salt of the Earth: We lead with humility, honesty, and heart—always.
• Do What’s Right: No shortcuts. We choose integrity over ease, every time.

Work location
Toronto, Ontario (hybrid).

About us

At NATIONAL, we are driven by purpose, creativity, and connection. For 50 years, our teams across Canada have helped organizations navigate change, build trust, and shape conversations that matter.

As one of Canada's largest independent communications consultancies, we partner with leading public and private organizations to solve complex business challenges through strategic communications, corporate affairs, capital markets expertise, and creative thinking.

Our Toronto team is looking for a senior communications leader with a strong background in financial communications, capital markets, and investor relations. This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys advising senior clients, making complicated business issues easier to understand, and working in a collaborative, fast-paced consulting environment.

If you are a trusted advisor who likes solving complex challenges, building lasting client relationships, and helping grow a dynamic practice, we would like to hear from you.

The role

This is a hands-on senior advisory opportunity for someone who wants to be both strategic and practical, commercially minded and collaborative, and comfortable advising clients when the stakes are high.

As Director, Corporate Communications, you will provide senior strategic counsel to executives, boards of directors, and investor relations teams. You will lead complex client mandates across corporate and financial communications, investor relations, capital markets initiatives, reputation management, crisis files, transaction communications, disclosure support, and special situations.

You will also play an important role in growing our practice. That means identifying and leading new business opportunities, expanding existing client relationships, mentoring colleagues, and connecting clients with the right expertise from across NATIONAL's practices and offices.

What you will do

As a senior member of the Toronto team, you will help clients communicate clearly in moments that matter to their business, their investors, their employees, their regulators, and other important stakeholders.

You will be expected to bring sound judgment, strong business instincts, and a clear understanding of how markets, media, investors, disclosure, and reputation intersect.

You will lead complex client mandates from planning through execution, making sure the work is thoughtful, high quality, delivered on time, and managed on budget.

You will build strong, enduring client relationships, identify opportunities to expand existing mandates, and lead new business opportunities that contribute to the growth of the Firm. You will also manage project planning, financial management, and resource allocation so that client objectives are met and the work runs smoothly.

You will collaborate with colleagues across NATIONAL's practices and offices to deliver integrated communications solutions that meet evolving client needs. You will mentor, coach, and develop team members, helping foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture.

You will stay close to capital markets trends, regulatory developments, and emerging communications practices so that your counsel is current, practical, and grounded in the realities of the market. You will also help strengthen NATIONAL's presence in the Canadian capital markets and financial communications community.

What you bring

You are a trusted advisor with a strong grounding in financial communications. You understand how to translate complex financial, market, and business issues into clear advice, credible messaging, and practical communications plans.

You are comfortable in senior rooms, including engaging with executives, boards, investor relations teams, legal advisors, bankers, analysts, and other stakeholders who are often part of high-profile, sensitive, or crisis-related mandates. You do not need to be a specialist in every situation, but you should bring the judgment and experience to know what matters, what questions to ask, and how to bring the right people together.

You likely bring:

• 10+ years of experience in financial and corporate communications, capital markets, investor relations, strategic communications, or a consulting or corporate advisory environment.
• Demonstrated experience providing strategic counsel to senior executives and leading complex communications or capital markets mandates, including crisis files.
• Exceptional writing, presentation, and strategic communications skills, with the ability to develop compelling messaging across multiple channels.
• Proven experience leading client relationships, managing budgets, and delivering complex projects in a fast-paced consulting environment.
• A strong understanding of capital markets, financial communications, and the evolving media and digital landscape.
• A bachelor's degree in Communications, Business, Finance, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related discipline. Experience advising publicly traded companies, investor relations teams or capital market participants is considered an asset. Familiarity with the Canadian capital markets landscape is also an asset.
• Comfort using AI-enabled tools, for example, ChatGPT.
• Nice to have: bilingualism in English and French.

How you work

You are strategic, but not removed from the work. You can see the larger picture, identify what matters, and turn advice into action. You are calm under pressure, clear in your counsel, and comfortable working in situations where the path forward is not always obvious.

You simplify complex issues, including financial and capital markets issues, and provide practical recommendations that clients can use. You bring a strong client-service mindset, build relationships naturally, and know how to manage stakeholders with confidence and discretion.

You are organized and comfortable managing budgets, timelines, resources, and tight deadlines. You can lead multiple priorities at once without losing sight of quality, detail, or client objectives.

You are collaborative, but highly self-sufficient. You can motivate teams, coach colleagues, contribute to an inclusive workplace, and draw on the strength of a national network when clients would benefit from additional expertise.

You are proactive, detail-oriented, adaptable, and committed to excellent client service.

What we offer

• A hybrid work environment and a supportive, collegial Toronto office culture.
• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.
• Opportunities to work on high-profile mandates with leading organizations across sectors.
• Professional development, coaching, and growth opportunities within a national team.
• Occasional travel as required by client and team needs.

Expected Compensation

The expected salary for this role is $103,500 - $115,000 CAD. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.

How to apply

Qualified candidates are invited to apply by submitting a resume and a brief cover letter outlining their interest in the role, relevant experience, and fit for a senior financial communications, corporate communications, and capital markets advisory role. If you are up for a new challenge to join Canada's PR Firm, we would like to hear from you.

NATIONAL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Should you require accommodation during the selection process, please inform us.

A vacancy currently exists for this position. As part of our recruitment process, we use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the screening, assessment, and selection of applicants for this role. Thank you for considering a career with NATIONAL. Please note that only candidates selected for further consideration will be contacted.

NATIONAL Public Relations provides creative communications solutions that move people in thought and actions. We bring together a team of 300 seasoned professionals, who are committed to helping organizations of all sizes and in all sectors understand their challenges and opportunities and solve the issues they are facing. For 47 years, NATIONAL has been at the center of issues and industries that matter, leading change for today and tomorrow.

NATIONAL is Canada’s leading public relations firm, with offices in Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal, Quebec City, Saint John, Halifax and St. John’s. Its network includes Time & Space, a leader in media strategy, data analysis, planning and execution.

NATIONAL Public Relations is an AVENIR GLOBAL company, the largest Canadian-owned global communications firm, ranked among the 25 largest in the world with offices in 23 locations across Canada, the U.S., Europe and the Middle East. Artificial intelligence is transforming every creative field. At Suno, we are building one of the world's leading generative music models, enabling millions of people to become musicians for the first time.

We are hiring the first Product Manager dedicated to our Research organization.

jobs.description: Role Specific Information Job Description About the Role As Beauty Advisor, you will drive sales through an authentic passion for beauty and engage clients by identifying their needs with a consultative approach and ensure an excellent overall client experience. You will maintain expert knowledge of top beauty brands, execute merchandise sets and support replenishment and visual standards according to Sephora at Kohl’s standards. What You’ll Do Build strong client loyalty and influence clients by identifying their needs and suggesting products to drive sales, including the opportunity to upsell products Demonstrate credibility to the client through knowledge of products and beauty trends Inspire clients through demonstrating products and application of products to drive sales Actively engage and complete all required training to expand knowledge Execute and maintain all Sephora visual merchandising and operational standards, including merchandise sets, tester maintenance and department cleanliness and hygiene standards Support omni-processing within the department Support inventory management from receipt to sale, including freight processing, back stocking, replenishment, inventory counts and price changes Support visual elements of the department and communicate missed or damaged product/fixtures to the supervisor All associates are responsible for: Acting with integrity and honesty and fostering teamwork in an engaged and inclusive culture Exercising good judgment and discernment when making decisions; taking appropriate partners as needed Supporting and executing safety and shortage reduction programs following company guidelines Accomplishing multiple tasks within established timeframes Following company policies, procedures, standards and guidelines Maintaining adherence to company safety policies for the safety of all associates and customers Receiving, understanding and proactively responding to direction from leaders and other company personnel Other responsibilities as assigned What Skills You Have Required Authentic passion for beauty Client-facing retail or service industry experience Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence in a clear and concise manner Flexible availability to work days, nights, weekends and holidays Essential Functions The requirements listed below are representative of functions you will be required to perform, however you may be required to perform additional functions. Kohl’s may revise this job description at any time. To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship. Ability to perform the accountabilities listed in the “What You’ll Do” Section. Ability to satisfactorily complete company training programs. Ability to comply with dress code requirements. Basic math and reading skills, legible handwriting, and basic computer operation. Ability to operate and communicate on multiple frequency devices, handheld scanners, and other technology equipment as directed. Ability to maintain prompt and regular attendance and meet scheduling requirements as set by the company. Perform work in accordance with the Physical Requirements section. Physical Requirements Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. frequently and occasionally over 50 lbs. with a two person lift. Ability to climb, squat, stoop, kneel, crouch, bend, twist, reach, lift, grasp, push and pull on a frequent basis. Ability to stand/walk for the duration of a scheduled shift (up to 8 hours). Ability to visually verify information and locate and inspect merchandise. Ability to comply with health and safety standards. Pay Range: $15.55 - $20.25 Kohl’s offers a variety of benefits to associates depending on full-time/part-time status and work hours, including: WORK LIFE BALANCE (PTO, Vacation Buy Program, Parental Leave), HEALTH & WELLNESS (Medical, Dental, Vision and other short and long term disability programs, Emergency health and wellness programs such as Accident Protection Plans, Critical Illness Plans and more), SAVINGS & RETIREMENT BENEFITS (401k, Flexible Spending Accounts and associate discount programs with Kohl’s partners), INSURANCE PROGRAMS (Life Insurance for you, your family or your pet, as well as other protection programs), and LIFE EVENTS (Legal and adoption assistance benefits). Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.
